scope: Four textbook seasons: separate summer, autumn and winter cues following spring batch-05

shots.narration_cue: Summer – The hemisphere tilted towards the Sun
shots.prompt: A polished child-friendly 3D animated park in summer. A single leafy tree stands beside a winding path with lush grass and small flowers. Bright warm sunshine pours across the same cheerful landscape for one continuous five-second shot. Leaves flutter gently and the camera glides smoothly, emphasizing the warm summer weather with natural movement and a clear uncluttered view.

shots.narration_cue: Autumn – Occurs between summer and winter
shots.prompt: A polished child-friendly 3D animated park in autumn. A single broad tree beside a winding path carries gold, amber and rust-colored leaves over grass turning pale. Several leaves drift naturally to the ground as the light becomes softer and cooler. Hold the same landscape for one continuous five-second shot with a restrained camera glide and clear seasonal motion.

shots.narration_cue: Winter – The hemisphere tilted away from the Sun
shots.prompt: A polished child-friendly 3D animated park in winter. A single bare tree stands beside a winding path under a pale blue sky, with light snow resting on branches and grass. Fine snowflakes fall gently through one continuous five-second shot while the camera glides smoothly across the quiet landscape. The cool light, bare branches and snow make the winter season immediately clear.
